raw_module_items.name: Closing a ticket counts the automatic "ticket closed" email as the agent's first response and as an outgoing response
raw_module_items.description_html:
Summary

When Customer Happiness is on, closing a ticket sends the "Your ticket #N has been closed" email. Desk saves that automatic email as an outbound reply from the ticket owner, so it becomes the ticket's first response and is counted on Headquarters as an Outgoing Response. A ticket no agent ever answered looks answered, and its first response time is really its time to close.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Make sure Customer Happiness is on (Settings, Customer Happiness, rating sent when the ticket is closed).

  2. Create a ticket in Customer Support with a requester email and assign it to an agent. Do not reply to it.

  3. About a minute later, close the ticket.

  4. Open the ticket's conversation and look at its Time to First Response.

  5. Open Headquarters for Customer Support and look at Outgoing Responses in Request Response Trend or Last 1 hour Responses.

Expected result

The automatic closed email is a notification, not an agent response. The ticket has no first response, the conversation does not list the email as an agent reply, and Headquarters Outgoing Responses does not count it, as in Zoho Desk.

Actual result

Ticket #340 had no agent reply. After closing it, the conversation shows "Your ticket #340 has been closed" as a reply from the ticket owner (direction outbound, mode reply), first_response_at equals the close time, and Time to First Response shows 1 minute (61 s). In the same hour one real agent reply was sent on #338, but Headquarters Outgoing Responses went from 0 to 2. On the first test run three closed tickets got first response times of 314–316 s from their closed emails, and Outgoing showed 4 for one real reply.

Additional notes

The closed email is only sent while Customer Happiness is on; with it off, closing adds no reply. The wrong values also feed every report that uses first response time. Screenshots attached: the ticket conversation and the API readings.

Environment

staging-desk.taviportal.com, Chromium, 21 October 2026, admin account.

raw_module_items.name: Headquarters First Response Time does not match the tickets' first response times
raw_module_items.description_html:
Summary

The First Response Time metric on Headquarters ("the average first response in a time window") does not equal the average of the first response times of the tickets answered in that window. In both tests the ticket answered first was left out.

Steps to reproduce

  1. In Customer Support, create two tickets at the same time and assign them.

  2. Reply to the first ticket after about 1 minute and to the second after about 2 minutes.

  3. Open each ticket and note its Time to First Response.

  4. Open Headquarters for Customer Support, add the First Response Time metric if needed, and set it to the last 1 hour. Wait a few minutes and refresh.

Expected result

First Response Time shows the average of the two tickets' first response times (62 s and 123 s, so about 93 s).

Actual result

Tickets #341 and #342 have first response times of 62 s and 123 s. Headquarters showed 128 s for six minutes in a row with no projection lag, which matches only the ticket answered second. Earlier the same day Headquarters showed 315 s while four tickets in the window had 61, 314, 316 and 315 s (average 251 s); the 61 s ticket, answered first, was again left out.

Additional notes

Read through GET /desk/hq/summary (first_response_avg_seconds) with the department and hours=1. Closing the second ticket did not change the value. The 314–316 s values in the earlier test came from the closed-email problem filed separately.

Environment

staging-desk.taviportal.com, Chromium, 21 October 2026, admin account.

raw_module_items.name: Headquarters layout save accepts invalid layouts (unknown card types, out-of-grid positions, duplicate ids)
raw_module_items.description_html:
Summary

The endpoint that saves a user's Headquarters layout stores whatever it is sent. Only the number of cards (at most 40) is checked. The page copes with the bad data today, but anything else that reads the layout gets stored junk.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Sign in to Desk and send PUT /api/v1/desk/hq/layout with a layout that has version 2, two cards with the same id at the same position, a card of type "evil", a card at x = -5 with width 0, a card 13 columns wide on the 12-column grid, and settings with channel "<script>alert(1)</script>" and hours 9999.
  2. Send GET /api/v1/desk/hq/layout.

Expected result

The save is refused with 400 and a message naming the bad field, as other Desk endpoints do. Only known card types, positions and sizes inside the grid, unique ids, and settings values the cards offer (channels from the list, hours 1–72, Show 10/25/50) are stored.

Actual result

The save answers 200 and GET returns the layout exactly as sent, including version 2, the duplicate id, type "evil", x = -5, w = 0, w = 13, the script text and hours 9999. A layout with 41 cards is the only one refused (422, "layout.components may hold at most 40 components."). After reload the board shows only the cards it understands, no script runs and no request fails, so users are not affected today.

Additional notes

Found while testing invalid input on Headquarters. The test layout was replaced with the original afterwards.

Environment

staging-desk.taviportal.com, Chromium, 21 October 2026, admin account.

raw_module_items.name: An open Headquarters page keeps showing old numbers after the user loses Headquarters access
raw_module_items.description_html:
Summary

If an agent has Headquarters open when an admin removes their Headquarters permission, the page keeps showing the last numbers as if they were live. Every 30-second refresh is refused in the background, but the page shows no message.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Sign in as a Desk Agent and open Headquarters. Leave it open.

  2. As an admin, give that agent a profile without the Headquarters permission (desk:hq:view).

  3. Wait two minutes and look at the agent's open Headquarters page.

Expected result

Once the refresh is refused, the page says the user no longer has access to Headquarters (or sends them to a page they can open) and stops showing the numbers.

Actual result

After 120 seconds the page still showed the full board with the same numbers and no message, while every refresh of GET /desk/hq/summary returned 403 "Missing required permission 'desk:hq:view'". A fresh sign-in by the same user is handled correctly: no Headquarters menu item, the landing page is Views, and /hq goes to Views.

Additional notes

The agent's original Desk Agent profile was restored after the test and the test profile was deleted.

Environment

staging-desk.taviportal.com, Chromium, 21 October 2026, Desk Agent account and admin account.

raw_module_items.name: Unassigning a ticket with only owner_id returns a 500 error
raw_module_items.description_html:
Summary

The ticket assign endpoint crashes with an internal error when it is asked to unassign a ticket and the request does not include team_id. The same request with team_id set to null works.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Create a ticket in Customer Support (it is assigned to its creator).
  2. Send POST /api/v1/desk/tickets/{ticket id}/assign with the body {"owner_id": null}.
  3. Send the same request with the body {"owner_id": null, "team_id": null}.

Expected result

The first request unassigns the ticket, treating a missing team_id as "no change" or null, or it is refused with 400 and a message saying what is missing.

Actual result

The first request returns 500 INTERNAL "An unexpected error occurred." and the ticket keeps its owner. The second returns 200 and the ticket is unassigned.

Additional notes

Found while setting up Headquarters test data. The Desk screens may always send team_id, so this mainly affects API callers and integrations. The test ticket was deleted.

Environment

staging-desk.taviportal.com, API, 21 October 2026, admin account.

raw_module_items.name: Resizing a Headquarters card with the keyboard moves the card instead
raw_module_items.description_html:
Summary

Each Headquarters card has a "Resize component" handle. With the mouse it resizes the card. With the keyboard it moves the card instead, so keyboard-only users cannot resize cards.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Open Headquarters with the default layout.
  2. Press Tab until the "Resize component" handle of Request Response Trend has focus (bottom-right corner of the card).
  3. Press Space, then Right Arrow, then Down Arrow, then Space.
  4. Look at the card, and listen to the screen reader announcement.

Expected result

The card grows by one column and one row, and the screen reader announces "Resized to 9 columns by 8 rows" (the page already has this message).

Actual result

The card is moved from column 1, row 1 to x 1, y 7, its size stays 8 × 7, the cards below shift down, and the screen reader announces "Moved to column 2, row 8". Doing the same with the mouse on the same handle resizes the card correctly (Last 1 hour Responses went from 4 × 7 to 4 × 8). Moving with the keyboard through "Move component" works.

Additional notes

Before and after screenshots attached. The layout was restored after the test.

Environment

staging-desk.taviportal.com, Chromium, 21 October 2026, admin account.

raw_module_items.name: Advanced Analytics for Desk: features Zoho Analytics for Zoho Desk has that Desk + Analytics are missing
raw_module_items.description_html:
Summary

We compared the Desk ⇄ Analytics integration (NDC-2277) with Zoho's "Advanced Analytics for Zoho Desk". This ticket lists only what is not built yet; the user stories for these items are in NDC-2365. The feature spec is NDC-2068 (Tavi Desk → Tavi Analytics user story); each item says where NDC-2068 mentions it. Updated 21 October after the spec run: item 5 is now a bug (NDC-2369) and item 11 was added.

Missing — inside Desk

  1. Advanced Analytics page in Desk. Desk → Analytics → Advanced Analytics still shows "Advanced Analytics — Desk data together with your other sources, data alerts and deeper analysis — is on its way. In Development". In Zoho this button opens the Analytics workspace with the Desk data. NDC-2068 P1 ("open reports from the Desk Analytics tab").
  2. Analytics entry in Desk Settings → Integrations, showing connection status, last sync, edit setup and disconnect. Today Integrations has only "CRM ⇄ Desk Integration" and "Email Providers". NDC-2068 stories 1 and 8.

Missing — Desk data sent to Analytics

  1. Agents, Departments and Teams as their own tables (name, email, role, status, members). Today only names appear inside Ticket Metrics, and the agent tables are availability, sessions and days. NDC-2068 data list.
  2. Calls table. Desk has a Calls module (3 calls on the test tenant), but Analytics has only Events and Tasks from Desk activities. NDC-2068 data list (optional activities).
  3. Four ticket fields are in no Desk table. Moved to bug NDC-2369: the fields are synced but hidden from the field list.

Missing — sync

  1. Bell and email message when a Desk table fails to sync. The notification settings have events for report schedules and alerts only; a Desk sync failure shows only on the workspace Overview. NDC-2068 story 7.
  2. Sync history for each Desk table: start, end, records added, updated and deleted, and result for every run. Today only the last run's counts are kept for automatic tables; scheduled tables do have run history. NDC-2068 story 7.

Missing — analysis

  1. Data alerts (notify me when a number crosses a limit). The notification types reporting.alert.triggered, recovered and attention and the permissions reporting:alert:read and manage exist, but there is no screen, and /reporting/alerts returns 404. The Desk Advanced Analytics page promises this. Not in NDC-2068.
  2. Query Table (SQL SELECT over the Desk tables). The New menu shows it disabled, as is Data Pipeline. Not in NDC-2068.
  3. Ask questions in plain words (AI) over Desk data. Not built. NDC-2068 P2.
  4. Link between Desk and CRM data. Desk Tickets has a CRM Deal field, but there is no relationship from Desk tables to CRM Deals or Contacts, so a report cannot combine them. The only link to another app is Omnichannel Conversations → Desk Ticket. Zoho joins CRM and Desk tables automatically. NDC-2068 P1 ("auto-join with CRM data").

Could not be checked

There is no non-owner account with an Analytics or reporting permission on tenant …0002, so per-user visibility of Desk data could not be checked. Please give a Desk agent (for example Agent A, Call Center) a reporting profile so we can test it.

Additional notes

Not gaps: sync timing (Desk tables sync about every 5 minutes, faster than Zoho's hourly best); Sync now (limited per table to once a minute instead of Zoho's 5 a day); default content (192 Desk reports and 26 Desk dashboards, more than Zoho's 75+); edit setup, field choice and schedules in the Import From Desk wizard; disconnect and reconnect in a non-default workspace; Desk department scoping and the rules for sending Desk reports (stricter than Zoho); Analytics report embed in the Desk dashboard builder. Choosing departments is not a gap, because Zoho connects the whole portal only.

Bugs found in the 21 October spec run: NDC-2367 to NDC-2375.

Test spec: Desk Specs/spec-desk-advanced-analytics.md in the QA repository.

Environment

staging-desk.taviportal.com and staging-analytics.taviportal.com, Chromium, 21 October 2026, admin account (tenant …0002).

raw_module_items.name: Advanced Analytics for Desk: user stories for the functions not built yet
raw_module_items.description_html:
Summary

One user story for each item in NDC-2364 (what Zoho Analytics for Zoho Desk has and the Desk ⇄ Analytics integration does not yet), plus one story each for the checks we could not run. Feature: NDC-2277. Spec: NDC-2068. Numbers match NDC-2364.

1. Open Advanced Analytics from Desk

As a support manager, I want the Advanced Analytics item in Desk to take me to the Desk data in Analytics, so that I can do deeper analysis without looking for another app.

  1. Given I have an Analytics profile, when I open Desk → Analytics → Advanced Analytics, then the page opens the Analytics workspace that holds the Desk tables, on a staging-analytics host, and no "In Development" text is shown.
  2. Given I have no Analytics profile, when I open it, then I see a plain message telling me to ask an administrator, and no broken page.

2. See and manage the Analytics connection from Desk settings

As a Desk admin, I want an Analytics entry under Settings → Integrations, so that I can see whether Desk data is reaching Analytics and change it without leaving Desk.

  1. Given Desk is connected, when I open Settings → Integrations → Analytics, then I see status, number of tables, last sync time and a link to manage the source in Analytics.
  2. Given I am not an admin, then I can see the status but cannot change it, and the API returns 403 for changes.
  3. Every change made from here is written to the Audit Log.

3. Agents, Departments and Teams tables

As a support manager, I want Agents, Departments and Teams as their own tables in Analytics, so that I can report on people and groups even when they have no tickets.

  1. Given Desk has agents, departments and teams, when the Desk source syncs, then three tables appear with name, email, role, status, department and team membership.
  2. Given an agent with no tickets, then the agent still appears in the Agents table.
  3. Given I rename a team in Desk, then the new name appears after the next sync.

4. Calls table

As a support manager, I want Desk calls in Analytics, so that I can report on call volume and duration next to tickets.

  1. Given Desk has calls, when the Desk source syncs, then a Calls table appears with subject, direction, duration, owner, ticket and contact.
  2. Given a call is deleted in Desk, then it leaves the table after the next sync.

5. Missing ticket fields

As a report author, I want the spam flag, resolution text, customer responded and approval status in Analytics, so that I can filter and count by them.

  1. When I open the Tickets or Ticket Metrics fields in Analytics, then these four fields are listed.
  2. Given a ticket marked as spam in Desk, then after the next sync its spam flag is true in Analytics.

6. Tell me when a Desk sync fails

As an Analytics admin, I want a bell and an email when a Desk table fails to sync, so that reports do not silently go stale.

  1. Given a Desk table sync fails, then admins get one bell notification and one email that name the table, the reason in plain words and what to do.
  2. Given the failure continues, then I am not sent a new message on every 5-minute run.
  3. The notification settings list "Data source sync failed" so I can turn it on or off.

7. Sync history for each table

As an Analytics admin, I want the run history of each Desk table, so that I can see when data stopped arriving and how much changed.

  1. When I open a Desk table's history, then each run shows start, end, records added, updated and deleted, and the result.
  2. A failed run shows the error in plain words.
  3. The history covers at least the last 30 days.

8. Data alerts

As a support manager, I want to set an alert on a Desk number (for example "open tickets over 50"), so that I am told when it happens instead of watching a dashboard.

  1. Given I create an alert on a report with a condition and recipients, when new Desk data meets the condition, then recipients get a bell and an email.
  2. When the number goes back under the limit, then a "recovered" message is sent once.
  3. Recipients only see data they are allowed to see in Desk.

9. Query Table

As a report author, I want to write a SQL SELECT over the Desk tables, so that I can build results the visual builder cannot make.

  1. When I choose New → Query Table, then I can write a SELECT, run it and save it as a table usable in reports.
  2. Statements other than SELECT are refused with a clear message.
  3. Desk department scoping still applies to the result.

10. Ask in plain words

As a support manager, I want to type a question such as "tickets closed last week by agent", so that I get a report without building it.

  1. When I type a question about Desk data, then I get a chart or table and can save it as a report.
  2. The answer only uses data I am allowed to see.

Checks we could not run

A. Per-user visibility of Desk data in Analytics. As a Desk agent with an Analytics profile, I want to see only the Desk data of my departments. Please give a Desk agent on tenant …0002 an Analytics profile so we can test it.

B. New Desk fields reach Analytics. As a Desk admin, I want a custom ticket field I add in Desk to appear in Analytics after the next sync (the source setting "Include new fields automatically" is on). Please allow us to add one QA custom ticket field on …0002 so we can test it.

Environment

staging-desk.taviportal.com and staging-analytics.taviportal.com, Chromium, 21 October 2026, admin account (tenant …0002).

raw_module_items.name: A ticket with a due date cannot be closed before that date
raw_module_items.description_html:
Summary

Closing a ticket fails once the ticket has a due date that is still in the future. The SLA sets a due date on new tickets automatically within seconds, so in practice agents cannot close a normal ticket before it is overdue. The close is refused with "'closed_time' must be on or after 'due_date'" and the ticket stays Open. This also breaks "Schedule and close ticket" in the reply box: the reply is scheduled, but the ticket is not closed.

Steps to reproduce

1. Sign in to Desk and create a new ticket in the techSupport department.

2. Wait about 15 seconds until Ticket Properties shows a Due Date (on our test ticket #668 it was 22/10/2026 12:16, set by the SLA).

3. Click "Close ticket", then confirm "Close ticket" in the dialog.

Expected result

The ticket is closed and its status becomes Closed. Closing a ticket before its due date is the normal case: it means the ticket was resolved in time.

Actual result

An error appears: "The records service rejected the update: RECORD_VALIDATION_FAILED … 'closed_time' must be on or after 'due_date'." The request POST /desk/tickets/{id}/close returns 422 and the ticket stays Open. The same happens through the API, and with "Schedule and close ticket" from the reply box: the scheduled reply is saved, but the close call that follows returns the same 422. A ticket closed within a second or two of being created, before the SLA has set its due date, closes normally (200). The same ticket fails once the due date is set.

Additional notes

Found while retesting NDC-2177 (Scheduled Replies). Test tickets were deleted afterwards.

Environment

staging-desk.taviportal.com, Chromium and API, 21 October 2026, owner account.

raw_module_items.name: Ticket Status and Tickets dashboards give different ticket counts for the same department
raw_module_items.description_html:
Summary

For the same user and the same department, the Ticket Status dashboard shows more open tickets than the Tickets dashboard shows tickets in total. Open Tickets is 89 while Total Tickets for the whole year is 77. Desk has 32 tickets with no department (24 from email, 6 from workflows, 2 manual). The Ticket Status, Overview and other metrics dashboards count these under the default department (techSupport); the Tickets dashboard does not count them at all. A manager therefore gets two different answers to "how many tickets does my department have".

Steps to reproduce

  1. Log in to Desk as an admin whose default department is techSupport.
  2. Open Analytics, then Dashboards, then Ticket Status Dashboard. Note Open Tickets.
  3. Open Module Dashboards, then Tickets Module, with the period This year. Note Total Tickets.
  4. Compare both with the Desk ticket list for techSupport.

Expected result

Both dashboards count the same tickets for the same department. A ticket with no department is either counted under one department everywhere, or nowhere, and Total Tickets is never smaller than Open Tickets.

Actual result

Ticket Status shows Open Tickets 89; the Tickets dashboard shows Total Tickets 77 for the year. The Desk list has 60 open techSupport tickets plus 27 open tickets with no department. The Tickets Module report "Tickets by Status" shows Open 59, the Ticket Status report of the same name shows Open 84. Without the department scope the two reports agree (131 and 129, the difference being 2 merged tickets).

Additional notes

Ticket Metrics (desk_ticket_facts) puts the 32 no-department tickets under techSupport (techSupport 99, empty 1); the Tickets table leaves them empty (techSupport 82, empty 33). The reports involved also share names: 16 Desk report names appear two or three times in the same folder, for example "Tickets by Status" three times. Found while running the NDC-2277 spec. Evidence attached.

Environment

staging-desk.taviportal.com, Chromium, 21 October 2026, admin account (tenant …0002).

raw_module_items.name: Tickets dashboard shows record ids instead of product and account names
raw_module_items.description_html:
Summary

On the Desk Tickets dashboard, the "Tickets by Product" and "Top Accounts" charts label their bars with long record ids such as 91c89c11-8dab-4f85-969a-87641767ab8b instead of the product and account names. Users cannot tell which product or account a bar belongs to.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Log in to Desk as an admin.
  2. Open Analytics, then Dashboards, then Module Dashboards, then Tickets Module, with the period This year.
  3. Scroll to "Tickets by Product" and "Top Accounts".

Expected result

Each bar is labelled with the product name or account name, as in Desk.

Actual result

The bars are labelled 91c89c11-8dab-4f85-969a-87641767ab8b (the product called "test"), 122f0665-94a0-434e-a1c7-ac77b72bf0be and 8d9180cc-fed6-4f48-83fc-aa0b169be13d (accounts).

Additional notes

Both reports group by the lookup id fields product_id and account_id of the Tickets table. The Ticket Metrics table already has product_name and account_name. NDC-1752 fixed the same problem for people's names. Found while running the NDC-2277 spec.

Environment

staging-desk.taviportal.com, Chromium, 21 October 2026, admin account (tenant …0002).

raw_module_items.name: Synced Desk ticket fields, including new custom fields, are hidden from report builders
raw_module_items.description_html:
Summary

The Desk Tickets table in Analytics receives more fields than it lets people use. Fields such as Spam, Resolution, Customer Responded, Approval Status, Ticket Number, Closed Time, First Response Time, Resolution Time, Happiness Rating and SLA Violated hold data and can be queried, but they are not in the field list, so nobody can pick them in a report. A custom ticket field added in Desk is synced too but never appears, although the Desk source setting "Include new fields automatically" is on.

Steps to reproduce

  1. In Desk, Setup, Modules and Fields, add a single-line field to Tickets and fill it on one ticket.
  2. In Analytics, Data Sources, wait for the next Desk sync, or use Refresh modules and Sync now on Tickets.
  3. Open the Tickets fields (or start a report on Tickets) and look for the new field and for Spam.

Expected result

Every field that is synced is offered in the field list, and a new Desk field appears after the next sync, as the "Include new fields automatically" setting says.

Actual result

The Tickets field list has 22 fields. 25 more fields hold data and answer queries, for example Spam (12 values), Approval Status (166), Closed Time (22). The custom field "QA AAD custom" was created at 09:51 UTC; after 25 minutes, Refresh modules (fields_inserted 0) and Sync now, the list still had 22 fields and new_field_count 0, while a query on it returned "QA AAD custom value".

Additional notes

This corrects item 5 of NDC-2364: the fields are synced, not missing; they are hidden. The custom field was removed after the test. Found while running the NDC-2277 spec.

Environment

raw_module_items.name: "Analytics dashboard" element in the Desk dashboard builder never lists any dashboard
raw_module_items.description_html:
Summary

In the Desk dashboard builder, Elements has an "Analytics dashboard" item for showing an Analytics dashboard inside Desk. Its picker always says "There are no Analytics dashboards you can embed", even when Analytics has dashboards built by users. The "Analytics report" item next to it works.

Steps to reproduce

  1. In Analytics, have at least one dashboard built in Analytics (for example "Ashtar Dashboard").
  2. In Desk, open Analytics, then Dashboards, and start a new dashboard.
  3. Open Elements and click "Analytics dashboard" under Advanced Analytics.

Expected result

The picker lists the Analytics dashboards the user can open, so one can be added to the Desk dashboard.

Actual result

The picker shows "There are no Analytics dashboards you can embed" and the dashboard list is empty. A dashboard created in Analytics during the test ("QA AAD embed dashboard") did not appear either.

Additional notes

The picker asks the server for dashboards with origin_app=analytics and gets 0. Dashboards do not carry an origin_app at all, so none ever match. The same filter for reports returns 13 reports, which is why "Analytics report" works. Found while running the NDC-2277 spec.

Environment

raw_module_items.name: A paused Desk table is reported as up to date, so reports show old numbers with no warning
raw_module_items.description_html:
Summary

When syncing is paused on a Desk table, Analytics keeps reporting that table as complete and current. Changes made in Desk while it is paused are missing from reports, and nothing tells the reader that the numbers are old.

Steps to reproduce

  1. In Analytics, Data Sources, pause syncing on the Desk table Ticket Tags.
  2. In Desk, add a tag to a ticket.
  3. Wait 10 minutes (two normal sync cycles) and open a report on Ticket Tags.

Expected result

The table and any report or dashboard using it show that the data is paused or behind schedule, so nobody reads old numbers as current.

Actual result

After 11 minutes paused (last sync 09:54:34) the new tag was missing, but the Desk data status still said "completed", stale false, complete true, and the report query carried no warning. After resuming, the tag arrived in about 4 minutes.

Additional notes

The app already has a "Behind schedule" message and a paused state; neither is used for this case. Pause all on the Desk source behaves the same way. The table was resumed after the test. Found while running the NDC-2277 spec.

Environment

staging-analytics.taviportal.com and staging-desk.taviportal.com, Chromium, 21 October 2026, admin account (tenant …0002).

raw_module_items.name: Data Sources page shows wrong connection and sync states in a second workspace

In a workspace other than the Default Workspace, the Data Sources page shows sources and tables in the wrong state. CRM and Omnichannel are listed as connected although they are not, and Desk tables that are working are shown as never synced and empty.

  1. In Analytics, create a new workspace.

The page subtitle also says "Sync CRM data into Analytics", on every workspace, although Desk, Omnichannel and Files are sources too.

Additional notes

The test workspace was deleted after the run. Found while running the NDC-2277 spec.

Environment

raw_module_items.name: A ticket shared with another department stays "not found" for that department for about half a minute
raw_module_items.description_html:
Summary

After a ticket is shared with another department, agents of that department cannot open it straight away. For about 30 to 35 seconds the ticket returns "not found", and only then does it open with the shared access level. An agent who follows a share notification or link right away sees an error for a ticket they have just been given.

Steps to reproduce

  1. As an administrator, open a Customer Support ticket, choose More ticket actions → Share, add the Call Center department with Read-only Access and save.

  2. Straight away, sign in as an agent who belongs to Call Center only and open the same ticket.

  3. Keep reopening the ticket every 5 seconds.

Expected result

The ticket opens for the Call Center agent as soon as the share is saved.

Actual result

The share is saved with 200 at 09:12:41. The agent's request for the ticket returns 404 "Ticket … was not found" at 0, 6, 11, 17, 22 and 28 seconds, and first returns 200 (read-only, cannot edit) at 34 seconds. A second run at 10:00:33 behaved the same, first opening at 32 seconds.

Additional notes

Seen while retesting NDC-2210. The share was removed and the test tickets deleted and purged afterwards. The evidence image shows the request log.

Environment

staging-desk.taviportal.com, API, 21 October 2026, tenant …0004, administrator sharing, Call Center agent opening.

raw_module_items.name: Sending a reply that the mail server rejects returns an error, but the reply is still saved on the ticket
raw_module_items.description_html:
Summary

When a reply cannot be delivered because the mail server rejects it, the send request fails with an error, yet the reply is stored on the ticket as a failed message. The sender is told the reply was not accepted while a copy of it was in fact saved, so a retry leaves two copies and the two signals contradict each other.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Create a ticket whose customer email is an address that cannot receive mail (for example one ending in .invalid).
  2. As an agent, send a reply on that ticket.
  3. Reload the ticket's replies.

Expected result

One consistent outcome: either the reply is refused and nothing is stored, or it is accepted and saved with a "failed to send" status that the agent can see and resend.

Actual result

The send returns 422 "The mail service rejected the message: SMTP 550". The ticket's replies then contain that same reply with status "failed" and error "SMTP 550".

Additional notes

Seen while retesting NDC-1893. The test ticket was deleted and purged afterwards.

Environment

staging-desk.taviportal.com, API, 21 October 2026, tenant …0004, agent account.

raw_module_items.name: Tag and canned reply delete dialogs say the delete is permanent, but deleted items go to the Recycle Bin

Summary

In Omnichannel settings, the confirmation shown before deleting a tag or a canned reply says the delete is permanent and cannot be undone.   1. Open Settings → Tags and choose Delete on a tag.
  2. Read the confirmation, then confirm.
  3. Open the Recycle Bin and restore the tag.
  4. Repeat with Settings → Canned replies.

Expected result

The dialog says the item will be moved to the Recycle Bin and can be restored within 60 days.

Actual result

The tag dialog says "This will permanently delete "QA C1275 Bin Tag"." The canned reply dialog says "This can't be undone. Operators will immediately lose access to this reply in the composer." Both items appeared in the Recycle Bin and could be restored.

Additional notes

Seen while retesting NDC-1275. The test tag and canned reply were deleted and purged afterwards. The background in the screenshots is blurred.

Environment

staging-omnichannel.taviportal.com, Chromium, 21 October 2026, tenant …0002, admin account.

raw_module_items.name: Modules and Fields | A required field can still be set to read-only for a profile, so its users cannot create records
raw_module_items.description_html:
Summary

NDC-2228 now refuses "Don't Show" (hidden) on a required field, but "Read Only" on the same required field is still accepted. A profile with a read-only required field cannot fill it, so every record it creates fails — the same trap NDC-2228 closed for hidden.

raw_module_items.name: Email Templates and Notifications: features Zoho Desk has that Desk is missing
raw_module_items.description_html:
Summary

We compared Desk's Email Templates and Notifications pages, and the Desk features that use them, with Zoho Desk. This ticket lists only what Desk has not built yet. The user stories for these items are in NDC-2390. The feature items are NDC-1985 (notification rules and email templates) and NDC-1984 (template engine with placeholders, Phase 1). Neither one names any of the functions below, so no item has a phase yet.

Missing — template settings

  1. Templates per department. In Zoho each template and folder belongs to one department and the list has a department picker. Today every template is shared by the whole company.

  2. Folder access for chosen teams, roles or agents. Today a folder can only be "Only me" or "All agents".

  3. Templates for the Tasks and Products modules. Today only Tickets, Contacts and Accounts.

  4. Editing a template as raw HTML ("Insert HTML"). Today the editor has the rich-text toolbar only.

  5. Starring templates as favourites so agents find them first (Zoho allows 50 per department).

  6. Custom fields as placeholders (ticket, contact and account custom fields). Today only 17 fixed fields.

  7. Placeholders for the ticket description, the latest reply and the latest comment.

  8. Placeholders for the customer's link to the ticket (Help Center) and an agent "open ticket" button. Today an agent link exists only in the SLA escalation email.

  9. More ticket placeholders: due date, channel, classification, team, closed time, overdue, escalated, language, happiness rating.

  10. Placeholders for the ticket owner's email and phone, the sending agent, and the company logo, website and address.

  11. Preview with a real ticket or contact. Today the preview uses sample data only. Zoho's API has a render call for a chosen record; Desk has no such call.

Missing — where templates are used

  1. An "Insert template" button in Reply, Reply All and Forward, with folders and starred templates. Today the reply editor offers snippets only.

  2. A way to send a Contacts or Accounts template. They can be created today, but nothing in Desk sends them. (Workflow alert templates are already listed in NDC-2203.)

  3. Editable emails for agent, team and department notifications. In Zoho every rule has its own template. Today these rules show "Sent as an in-app and email notification" with fixed text and no template picker.

  4. Custom templates for the CC emails about a new ticket, a reply, closing and comments. Today only "Adding CCs to an existing ticket" can use one.

Missing — notification rules

  1. Department rules "Receiving a moved ticket" and "Receiving a shared ticket". The app has their text, but GET /desk/notification-rules/departments/{id} does not return them, so they never appear.

  2. Team rule "Mentioning in a ticket". Same as above: the text exists but the rule is not returned.

  3. Agent rules for a comment that is edited or deleted.

  4. Agent and team rules for activities: a call, task or event assigned or completed, or an @mention in one.

  5. Agent rule "Receiving a ticket for review", for approvals.

Missing — agent notification panel

  1. An "@Mentions" filter (mine and my team's) in the bell panel. Today the filters are All, Unread and Flagged.

  2. A page for personal notification settings. The bell's "Settings" button opens /settings/notifications/preferences, which has no page and lands on Headquarters. GET/PUT /notifications/preferences/me already works and covers 22 Desk events across 4 channels, but there is no screen for it. Department mute is already built.

Could not be checked

SMS: the page shows "No SMS gateway is configured on this platform.", so SMS rules and SMS templates could not be tested. Email failure alerts per department: the bell shows mail connection failures, but no bounced ticket reply was available to check. Delivery to customers: mail.tm never receives Desk mail. Please configure an SMS gateway on staging, and give QA a real customer mailbox, so we can test SMS rules and the emails as customers receive them.

Additional notes

Not gaps: a "send test email" button and per-language templates (Zoho has neither natively); the 200-template cap and the Clone action (Desk only, fine); a send-email action in macros (Zoho has none); workflow email alerts with a template and the "Send email reply" action (already NDC-2203); SLA escalation gaps (NDC-2266); Help Center invitation emails (part of NDC-1990); Blueprint transition emails (Blueprint is not built); department mute in the bell (built).

Four possible bugs, to check separately:

  • CC rules are email-only, but the page labels them "Sent as an in-app and email notification".

  • In Customer Support, "Receiving a new ticket" is bound to "Test Email Template", which has no "Used for" email.

  • The bell's Settings button lands on Headquarters.

  • The API's acknowledgement text says it is switched on "in Channels → Email", but the Notifications page says its own rule decides.

Test spec: Desk Specs/spec-desk-email-templates-notifications.md in the QA repository. Nothing was changed on the tenant.

Environment

staging-desk.taviportal.com, Chromium, 21 October 2026, admin account.

raw_module_items.name: Email Templates and Notifications: user stories for the functions not built yet
raw_module_items.description_html:
Summary

One user story for each missing function in NDC-2389, numbered the same way, plus stories for the parts that could not be checked. The feature items are NDC-1985 and NDC-1984.

Template settings

  1. As an admin, I want each email template and folder to belong to a department, so that each team sees only its own templates. AC: 1) Given I create a template, when I pick a department, then the template is listed only under that department. 2) Given the list, when I change the department picker, then only that department's templates show.

  2. As an admin, I want to share a folder with chosen teams, roles or agents, so that only the right people can use its templates. AC: 1) Given a folder shared with Team A, when an agent outside Team A opens templates, then the folder is hidden from them. 2) The API refuses that folder's templates to the agent.

  3. As an admin, I want templates for Tasks and Products, so that alerts about them have proper wording. AC: 1) Given the editor, when I pick Tasks or Products, then the placeholders for that module are offered.

  4. As an admin, I want to edit a template as HTML, so that I can paste a designed email. AC: 1) Given the editor, when I switch to HTML, then I can edit the source and the preview shows the result. 2) Scripts are still removed on save.

  5. As an agent, I want to star templates, so that the ones I use most come first. AC: 1) Given a starred template, when I open the template picker in a reply, then it shows under Starred. 2) At most 50 starred per department.

  6. As an admin, I want custom fields as placeholders, so that emails can include our own data. AC: 1) Given a ticket custom field, when I open Insert field, then it is listed. 2) When the email is sent, then the field's value is filled in.

  7. As an admin, I want placeholders for the ticket description, the latest reply and the latest comment, so that a notification can quote them. AC: 1) When the email is sent, then the text appears as plain, safe content.

  8. As an admin, I want a customer ticket link and an agent ticket button, so that readers can open the ticket in one click. AC: 1) The customer link opens the ticket in the Help Center. 2) The agent button opens it in Desk.

  9. As an admin, I want more ticket placeholders (due date, channel, classification, team, closed time, overdue, escalated, language, rating), so that emails can show them. AC: 1) Each one is in Insert field and filled in when sent.

  10. As an admin, I want placeholders for the owner's email and phone, the sending agent, and the company logo, website and address, so that emails carry contact details and branding. AC: 1) Each one is filled in when sent, and the logo shows as an image.

  11. As an admin, I want to preview a template with a real ticket or contact, so that I see exactly what will be sent. AC: 1) Given the preview, when I pick a ticket, then the placeholders are filled from that ticket. 2) The API offers the same render call.

Where templates are used

  1. As an agent, I want an "Insert template" button in Reply, Reply All and Forward, so that I don't retype common answers. AC: 1) Given the reply editor, when I pick a template, then its subject and body are filled with the ticket's values. 2) Folders and starred templates are shown. 3) Only templates I may see are listed.

  2. As an agent, I want to send a Contacts or Accounts template to a contact or account, so that those templates have a use. AC: 1) Given a contact record, when I choose Send email, then I can pick a Contacts template and it is sent with the contact's values.

  3. As an admin, I want to edit the email for each agent, team and department rule, so that internal emails say what we want. AC: 1) Given an agent rule, when I open it, then I can pick or edit its template. 2) The next notification uses it.

  4. As an admin, I want custom templates for the CC emails about a new ticket, a reply, closing and comments, so that CC'd people get our wording. AC: 1) Each CC rule offers a template picker. 2) The next email uses the chosen template.

Notification rules

  1. As an admin, I want the "Receiving a moved ticket" and "Receiving a shared ticket" rules, so that agents know when work arrives in their department. AC: 1) Both rules show and can be switched on or off. 2) When a ticket is moved or shared, then every agent in the department is notified.

  2. As an admin, I want a team "Mentioning in a ticket" rule, so that a team learns it was @mentioned. AC: 1) When a team is mentioned, then each member gets the notification.

  3. As an agent, I want to be told when a comment on my ticket is edited or deleted, so that I don't miss changes. AC: 1) Each rule can be switched on or off. 2) A deleted comment's text is not repeated.

  4. As an agent, I want notifications when a call, task or event is assigned to me or my team, completed, or mentions me, so that I keep up with activities. AC: 1) Each rule exists for agents and teams and works per department.

  5. As an approver, I want an email when a ticket is sent to me for review, so that approvals are not delayed. AC: 1) When a ticket needs my approval, then I get an in-app notification and an email with a link to it.

Agent notification panel

  1. As an agent, I want an @Mentions filter in the bell, so that I see quickly where I or my team was mentioned. AC: 1) The filter shows only mentions of me, with a toggle for my team's mentions.

  2. As an agent, I want a page to choose which events notify me and on which channels, so that I control the noise. AC: 1) The bell's Settings button opens this page. 2) It lists the Desk events with an in-app and email switch for each. 3) Changes save through /notifications/preferences/me and take effect at once.

Could not be checked

  1. As an admin, I want SMS notifications with editable SMS templates (500 characters), so that customers without email are reached. Please configure an SMS gateway on staging so we can test this.

  2. As an admin, I want agents alerted when an email to a customer fails, per department, so that failures get fixed. Please give us a way to produce a bounce on staging so we can test this.

  3. As a customer, I want to receive every notification email correctly, so that I know what is happening with my ticket. Please give QA a real customer mailbox so we can check delivery.

Environment

staging-desk.taviportal.com, Chromium, 21 October 2026, admin account.

raw_module_items.name: CRM + Desk Integration: features Zoho CRM + Desk has that TAVI is missing
raw_module_items.description_html:
Summary

We compared TAVI's CRM ⇄ Desk integration with a live Zoho Desk + Zoho CRM integration and the Zoho help docs. This ticket lists what Zoho has and TAVI does not have yet. The feature spec is NDC-1669; each item says where it is in NDC-1669, if it is there. Each item has an annotated image (TAVI left, Zoho right) named in the item. Bugs found while testing are filed separately (titles start with "CRM - Desk Integration |").

Already done in TAVI

  • Connect, Disconnect, Pause with a reason and Resume; the Overview shows status, connection dates and a live sync queue.

  • Contacts and Accounts sync, two-way or CRM → Desk, with field mapping (custom fields too); sync takes about 5 seconds.

  • Contacts are matched by email (case ignored), accounts by name; contacts without email sync too.

  • Delete preferences for both directions (Keep and flag, Keep but unlink, Delete; Desk side: Never delete, Delete).

  • CRM Related Lists, Sync History, Failure Log with Retry and Discard, "Sync all customers".

  • CRM pane on Desk tickets, contacts and accounts (Info, Potentials, Notes, Activities), Open in CRM, Update from CRM, manual Link and Unlink.

  • Profile permissions for CRM data per profile, for Accounts and Contacts, per section and activity type, enforced by the API.

  • Handshake Mode (Customers, Potentials, Contacts/Leads, New).

  • Desk Tickets card on CRM records with statistics, filters, New ticket, Link to deal, Close, Update field, Delete; Desk ticket workspace inside CRM; Ticket Visibility.

  • CRM notifications for 7 Desk events, "Notify the CRM contact owner", @mention of CRM users.

  • TAVI also has things Zoho does not have: Closed-Won deals become Desk contracts, phone calls copied to Desk, sync direction per field, a settings API.

Missing — sync settings

  1. Products sync: choose the Desk departments, "Also sync the product's customer (contact and account) associations", product field mapping. Today there is no Products row and /desk/integrations/crm/products returns 404. NDC-1669 §3, Phase 4. Image 01.

  2. Limit the sync to chosen CRM list views of Accounts and Contacts. Today every record syncs. NDC-1669 §2, Phase 1. Image 02.

  3. Match contacts on the Secondary Email, with Zoho's overwrite warning. Today only the primary email is used. NDC-1669 §2, Phase 1. Image 03.

  4. "Delete in Desk only if there are no associates" for a deleted CRM contact or account. NDC-1669 §5, Phase 2. Image 04.

  5. Report when the initial sync finishes (Zoho emails added / updated / ignored counts and the skip reasons). Today there is no email and no notice. NDC-1669 §4. Image 10.

  6. CRM Leads are not considered: a Desk contact whose email belongs to a CRM Lead is created as a new CRM contact. Zoho does not create it (source: Zoho community). NDC-1669 §2. Image 11.

  7. The 12-month window of the first sync is not stated on the screen (Zoho: "Only the records created or modified in the last year will be synced"). NDC-1669 §4. Image 18.

  8. No handling when the integrated user becomes inactive (Zoho asks the other admins to re-point the integration). Image 15.

Missing — where agents see CRM data

  1. All CRM fields in the CRM pane, custom fields included. Today 8 fixed fields; the list is in the settings (panel.info_fields) but there is no screen to change it. NDC-1669 §7, Phase 3. Image 05.

  2. Handshake Mode hides empty columns in Zoho. Today an empty Customers column is shown ("No tickets in this Queue"). NDC-1669 §8. Image 19.

Missing — CRM side

  1. Ticket filters Escalated, Overdue and High Priority on the CRM Desk Tickets card. Today All / Open / On hold / Closed. Image 06.

  2. Mutual Users list and "Invite users to Desk" (as Agent, Light Agent or Admin) on the CRM integration page. Image 07.

  3. CRM users added to Desk as Light Agents, and CRM-only users allowed to comment on tickets. Today they have no Desk profile and a comment gets 403. NDC-1669 §9. Image 12.

  4. "@CRM Contact Owner" mention in a ticket comment. Mentioning a named CRM user works. NDC-1669 §9. Image 13.

  5. Reply, comment or update from the CRM notification (Zoho Signals). Today the bell entry only opens the record. Image 14.

Missing — automation

  1. "CRM Contact Type" condition (Customer, Potential, Contact, Lead) in SLA and assignment rules. Image 08.

Missing — permissions

  1. Default CRM data access: in Zoho only the Administrator profile has access after connecting. Today every profile starts with Full Access, also right after a new Connect. The middle level is called "Custom Access"; Zoho calls it "Restricted Access". NDC-1669 §6, Phase 3. Image 09.

Missing — out of NDC-1669 scope (listed so the comparison is complete)

  1. Voice of the Customer in CRM from Desk tickets (Zoho Zia, Enterprise).

  2. Cross-app analytics joining CRM and Desk data (Zoho Analytics).

Environment

staging-crm.taviportal.com and staging-desk.taviportal.com (tenant NDC-Staging), Edge and Chrome, 18–21 October 2026, owner, Desk agent and CRM-only accounts. Zoho Desk (taviportal) + Zoho CRM (org943261092).

Already done in TAVI
Connect, Disconnect, Pause with a reason and Resume; the Overview shows status, connection dates and a live sync queue.
Contacts and Accounts sync, two-way or CRM → Desk, with field mapping (custom fields too); sync takes about 5 seconds.
Contacts are matched by email (case ignored), accounts by name; contacts without email sync too.
Delete preferences for both directions (Keep and flag, Keep but unlink, Delete; Desk side: Never delete, Delete).
CRM Related Lists, Sync History, Failure Log with Retry and Discard, "Sync all customers".
CRM pane on Desk tickets, contacts and accounts (Info, Potentials, Notes, Activities), Open in CRM, Update from CRM, manual Link and Unlink.
Profile permissions for CRM data per profile, for Accounts and Contacts, per section and activity type, enforced by the API.
Handshake Mode (Customers, Potentials, Contacts/Leads, New).
Desk Tickets card on CRM records with statistics, filters, New ticket, Link to deal, Close, Update field, Delete; Desk ticket workspace inside CRM; Ticket Visibility.
CRM notifications for 7 Desk events, "Notify the CRM contact owner", @mention of CRM users.
TAVI also has things Zoho does not have: Closed-Won deals become Desk contracts, phone calls copied to Desk, sync direction per field, a settings API.
Missing — sync settings
Products sync: choose the Desk departments, "Also sync the product's customer (contact and account) associations", product field mapping. Today there is no Products row and /desk/integrations/crm/products returns 404. NDC-1669 §3, Phase 4. Image 01.
Limit the sync to chosen CRM list views of Accounts and Contacts. Today every record syncs. NDC-1669 §2, Phase 1. Image 02.
Match contacts on the Secondary Email, with Zoho's overwrite warning. Today only the primary email is used. NDC-1669 §2, Phase 1. Image 03.
"Delete in Desk only if there are no associates" for a deleted CRM contact or account. NDC-1669 §5, Phase 2. Image 04.
Report when the initial sync finishes (Zoho emails added / updated / ignored counts and the skip reasons). Today there is no email and no notice. NDC-1669 §4. Image 10.
CRM Leads are not considered: a Desk contact whose email belongs to a CRM Lead is created as a new CRM contact. Zoho does not create it (source: Zoho community). NDC-1669 §2. Image 11.
The 12-month window of the first sync is not stated on the screen (Zoho: "Only the records created or modified in the last year will be synced"). NDC-1669 §4. Image 18.
No handling when the integrated user becomes inactive (Zoho asks the other admins to re-point the integration). Image 15.
Missing — where agents see CRM data
All CRM fields in the CRM pane, custom fields included. Today 8 fixed fields; the list is in the settings (panel.info_fields) but there is no screen to change it. NDC-1669 §7, Phase 3. Image 05.
Handshake Mode hides empty columns in Zoho. Today an empty Customers column is shown ("No tickets in this Queue"). NDC-1669 §8. Image 19.
Missing — CRM side
Ticket filters Escalated, Overdue and High Priority on the CRM Desk Tickets card. Today All / Open / On hold / Closed. Image 06.
Mutual Users list and "Invite users to Desk" (as Agent, Light Agent or Admin) on the CRM integration page. Image 07.
CRM users added to Desk as Light Agents, and CRM-only users allowed to comment on tickets. Today they have no Desk profile and a comment gets 403. NDC-1669 §9. Image 12.
"@CRM Contact Owner" mention in a ticket comment. Mentioning a named CRM user works. NDC-1669 §9. Image 13.
Reply, comment or update from the CRM notification (Zoho Signals). Today the bell entry only opens the record. Image 14.
Missing — automation
"CRM Contact Type" condition (Customer, Potential, Contact, Lead) in SLA and assignment rules. Image 08.
Missing — permissions
Default CRM data access: in Zoho only the Administrator profile has access after connecting. Today every profile starts with Full Access, also right after a new Connect. The middle level is called "Custom Access"; Zoho calls it "Restricted Access". NDC-1669 §6, Phase 3. Image 09.
Missing — out of NDC-1669 scope (listed so the comparison is complete)
Voice of the Customer in CRM from Desk tickets (Zoho Zia, Enterprise).
Cross-app analytics joining CRM and Desk data (Zoho Analytics).
Environment
staging-crm.taviportal.com and staging-desk.taviportal.com (tenant NDC-Staging), Edge and Chrome, 18–21 October 2026, owner, Desk agent and CRM-only accounts. Zoho Desk (taviportal) + Zoho CRM (org943261092).

raw_module_items.name: CRM - Desk Integration | Unlink does not stop the sync: the next change links the pair again by email
raw_module_items.description_html:
Summary

After Unlink, TAVI's own dialog says "Syncing stops for this record until it is linked again." In practice the very next change on the CRM record matches the Desk contact again by email and the change is written to Desk. An agent cannot keep a Desk contact apart from its CRM record.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Take a linked contact pair (Desk contact and CRM contact with the same email).

  2. Desk contact → CRM pane → Unlink → confirm.

  3. In CRM, change the contact's Title.

  4. Wait about 40 seconds and open the Desk contact and the link list.

Expected result

The record stays unlinked and the CRM change is not written to Desk, as the Unlink dialog promises.

Actual result

The link is back (sync_status synced, match_source match_existing) and the Desk Title shows the CRM value. Linking manually afterwards answers 409 "The crm record is already linked."

Request

DELETE /api/v1/desk/integrations/crm/links/{linkId}                 -> 204
PATCH  /api/v1/modules/{crm contacts}/records/{id} {title}         -> 200
GET    /api/v1/desk/integrations/crm/links?kind=contact            -> link present again, match_existing
POST   /api/v1/desk/integrations/crm/links {kind, crm_record_id, desk_record_id} -> 409

Evidence

Annotated image CD-01 (executions/execu_2026-10-20_crm-desk-integration/evidence/CD-01-unlink-does-not-stop-sync-vs-zoho.png) is attached or will be attached to this ticket.

Environment

staging-desk.taviportal.com and staging-crm.taviportal.com (tenant NDC-Staging), API, 20 October 2026, owner account. QA records deleted after the run.

Additional notes

  • Found while executing the CRM ⇄ Desk Integration spec (rows I9, I8); missing features are in NDC-2392; PRD NDC-1669.

  • Full bug report: executions/execu_2026-10-20_crm-desk-integration/bug-report.html (CD-01) in the QA repository.

raw_module_items.name: CRM - Desk Integration | Handshake Mode is still offered while the sync is paused
raw_module_items.description_html:
Summary

While the integration is paused, the ticket list Layout picker still offers Handshake Mode, so agents keep sorting tickets by CRM deal data that is no longer updated. When the integration is disconnected the option is hidden correctly.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Desk → Settings → CRM ⇄ Desk Integration → Pause sync (any reason).

  2. Desk → Tickets → All Tickets → open the Layout picker ("Classic View ▾").

  3. Control: Disconnect and open the picker again.

Expected result

Handshake Mode is removed from the picker with an explanation while the integration is paused or disconnected (NDC-1669 §8 AC). Zoho: pausing stops all data exchange and Handshake needs the integration.

Actual result

Paused: Handshake Mode is listed under Work Modes and can be picked. Disconnected: hidden (correct).

raw_module_items.name: CRM - Desk Integration | The settings API saves invalid field mappings
raw_module_items.description_html:
Summary

The mapping editor validates its rows, but PUT /api/v1/desk/integrations/crm/config accepts a mapping to a CRM field that does not exist, to a Desk field that does not exist, a lookup field, and a row with an empty CRM field. All four are saved with 200. Other checks (direction, enums, read-only target, one-way pair) are correctly refused with 422 CRM_SYNC_MAPPING_INVALID.

Steps to reproduce

  1. GET /api/v1/desk/integrations/crm/config.

  2. Add one contact mapping row and PUT the body back with the fresh row_version, once for each case below.

Request

contacts.mappings += {crm_field:"no_such_field_qa", desk_field:"description"}  -> 200
contacts.mappings += {crm_field:"description", desk_field:"no_such_field_qa"}  -> 200
contacts.mappings += {crm_field:"account_id" (lookup), desk_field:"description"} -> 200
contacts.mappings += {crm_field:"", desk_field:"description"}                   -> 200

Expected result

422 with the codes the app already knows: crm_field_unknown, desk_field_unknown, lookup_not_mappable, incomplete ("Pick a CRM field or clear this mapping.").

Actual result

200 for all four; the row is stored (our test put the baseline back straight away).

Evidence

Annotated image CD-04 (executions/execu_2026-10-20_crm-desk-integration/evidence/CD-04-invalid-mappings-saved-vs-zoho.png) is attached or will be attached to this ticket.

Environment

staging-desk.taviportal.com (tenant NDC-Staging), API, 20 October 2026, owner account.

Additional notes

  • Spec rows C17, C10; missing features are in NDC-2392; PRD NDC-1669.

  • Same kind of problem as NDC-1273 (Omnichannel CRM config), but in the Desk integration API.

  • Full bug report: executions/execu_2026-10-20_crm-desk-integration/bug-report.html (CD-04) in the QA repository.

raw_module_items.name: CRM - Desk Integration | Settings save without row_version is accepted, so the lost-update check can be skipped
raw_module_items.description_html:
Summary

A save with an old row_version is refused with 409 (correct), but a save that leaves row_version out is accepted and overwrites whatever another admin saved in between.

Steps to reproduce

  1. GET /api/v1/desk/integrations/crm/config.

  2. Make one harmless change and PUT the body without the row_version key.

Request

PUT /api/v1/desk/integrations/crm/config (old row_version)  -> 409 CONFLICT
PUT /api/v1/desk/integrations/crm/config (no row_version)   -> 200, saved

Expected result

The version is required: 400/409/428, like the stale case ("Another administrator saved these settings while you were editing…").

Actual result

200; the change is stored and row_version moves on.

Evidence

Annotated image CD-05 (executions/execu_2026-10-20_crm-desk-integration/evidence/CD-05-save-without-row-version-vs-zoho.png) is attached or will be attached to this ticket.

Environment

staging-desk.taviportal.com (tenant NDC-Staging), API, 20 October 2026, owner account; settings restored right after.

Additional notes

  • Spec row F5; missing features are in NDC-2392; PRD NDC-1669.

  • Full bug report: executions/execu_2026-10-20_crm-desk-integration/bug-report.html (CD-05) in the QA repository.

raw_module_items.name: CRM - Desk Integration | Changing the delete preference applies to a delete made earlier
raw_module_items.description_html:
Summary

A CRM contact is deleted while "Keep the Desk contact and flag its link for review" is set. If the preference is changed to "Delete the corresponding Desk contact" before that delete has synced, the Desk contact is deleted. NDC-1669 §5 says changing the preference is not retroactive. Seen twice.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Configuration Details → Preferences: "On deleting a CRM contact" = Keep (default).

  2. Pause sync (or have a busy queue) and delete a linked CRM contact.

  3. Change the preference to "Delete the corresponding Desk contact" and save.

  4. Resume, wait about 45 seconds, open the Desk contact.

Expected result

The delete keeps the preference that was in force when it happened (Keep): the Desk contact stays and its link is flagged. NDC-1669 §5 AC: not retroactive.

Actual result

The Desk contact is deleted under the new preference.

Evidence

Annotated image CD-13 (executions/execu_2026-10-20_crm-desk-integration/evidence/CD-13-delete-preference-retroactive-vs-zoho.png) is attached or will be attached to this ticket.

raw_module_items.name: CRM - Desk Integration | A Desk contact deleted by the integration is not in the recycle bin and cannot be restored
raw_module_items.description_html:
Summary

With "Delete the corresponding Desk contact", deleting the CRM contact removes the Desk contact, but the Desk contact is not in the Desk recycle bin. TAVI's own setting note says "The Desk contact goes to the Desk recycle bin together with … its tickets … and can be restored from there." Data deleted this way cannot be restored.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Configuration Details → Preferences: "On deleting a CRM contact" = Delete the corresponding Desk contact.

  2. Delete a linked CRM contact.

  3. Desk → Settings → Recycle Bin: look for the Desk contact (API GET /api/v1/audit/recycle-bin/items?app_key=desk).

Expected result

The Desk contact (and its tickets) is in the Desk recycle bin and can be restored, as the setting promises. Zoho: "the record and its associates go to the Desk recycle bin".

Actual result

GET of the Desk contact answers 404 and there is no recycle-bin entry for it (200 newest Desk items checked); a restore is impossible.

Evidence

raw_module_items.name: CRM - Desk Integration | "Lock CRM-owned fields on the contract" does not stop edits in Desk
raw_module_items.description_html:
Summary

With "Lock CRM-owned fields on the contract" on (the default), the contract name, which comes from the CRM deal name, can still be changed in Desk and is saved. The next deal update then overwrites or conflicts with it.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Configuration Details → Contracts: "Lock CRM-owned fields on the contract" = on (default).

  2. Win a deal in CRM so a Desk contract is created; give the contract a support plan, account and dates so it is valid.

  3. Change the contract name in Desk.

Request

PATCH /api/v1/modules/{desk contracts}/records/{id} {support_plan, account_id, start_date, end_date} -> 200
PATCH /api/v1/modules/{desk contracts}/records/{id} {contract_name: "QA CD edited in Desk"}        -> 200, saved
(lock switched off) PATCH … {contract_name}                                                          -> 200 (same result)

Expected result

CRM-owned contract fields (contract name, value, owner, description, start date) are read-only in Desk while the lock is on; an edit is refused with a clear message.

Actual result

200; the contract name is changed in Desk. The result is the same with the lock off.

raw_module_items.name: Data Administration: features Zoho Desk has that Desk is missing
raw_module_items.description_html:
Summary

We compared Desk's Data Administration section with Zoho Desk. This ticket lists only what Desk has not built yet; the user stories are in NDC-2495. The feature spec is NDC-1661, with NDC-1662 (Import / Export), NDC-1663 (Backup), NDC-1664 (Audit) and NDC-1665 (Recycle Bin). Each item says where it sits in those items.

Missing — Import

  1. Importing a ZIP with one CSV per module. Files are matched to modules by file name, unmatched files go to an "Unmapped" tray, and modules load in the order Accounts, Contacts, Tickets. Today one module per import. NDC-1662 P0.

  2. Knowledge Base articles in Import and Export. Today both pickers list only Accounts, Calls, Contacts, Contracts, Events, Products, Tasks, Tickets and Time Entries. NDC-1662 P0.

Missing — Export

  1. Exporting a saved view or records matching criteria from the Export page. Today the page exports all records only; a filtered export is possible only from a module list. NDC-1662 P0.

  2. Choosing which fields go into the file. Today every exportable field is always included. NDC-1662 P0.

  3. A date filter: created, modified, closed or completed time, over a preset or custom range. NDC-1662 P0.

  4. Downloading an export again from Export history, with the link valid for 7 days. Today the file downloads once in the browser and the history row has no link. NDC-1662 P0.

  5. An email and an in-app notice when an export is ready. NDC-1662 P0.

  6. Protecting an export with a password (8+ characters, upper case, lower case, digit, special character). NDC-1662 P1.

  7. Filters on Export history: module, user, time and status. Today the list only has "Load more". NDC-1662 P1.

Missing — Data Backup

  1. Backup limited to the account owner (primary contact). Today any user with the "Back Up Data" permission can use it. NDC-1663 P0.

  2. One full backup per 30 days, showing the next date a full backup is allowed. Today the app has no such limit or message, only "A backup is already queued or in progress". NDC-1663 P0.

  3. Backup Logs: configuration set, backup scheduled, ready to download, download started, schedule stopped. Today only Backup history, plus backup rows in the Bulk Actions Log. NDC-1663 P1.

Missing — Audit Log

  1. The IP address on each entry. GET /audit/events already returns source_ip, but the page does not show it. NDC-1664 P0.

  2. The department on each entry, and a Department filter. NDC-1664 P0.

  3. A custom date range filter. Today only Last 24 hours, 7, 30 and 90 days, 1 year and 3 years. NDC-1664 P0.

  4. Audit export rules: a maximum range per file (Zoho 60 days, NDC-1664 says 30), 50 exports a day, one export at a time, and an email when it is ready. Today Export Audit Log downloads the filtered list straight away with none of these. NDC-1664 P1.

Missing — Sandbox and Migration

  1. Deploying sandbox changes to production (a change set marked Qualified or Conflict). Today a sandbox can be created, opened, refreshed, given members, viewed in a log and deleted, but nothing moves back to production. Sandbox is a non-goal in NDC-1661.

  2. Migration from other help desks: Freshdesk, Salesforce, Kayako, Intercom, HappyFox, Help Scout and others. Today Migration supports Zendesk only. Migration connectors are a non-goal in NDC-1661.

Could not be checked

Custom modules in Import, Export, Backup and the Recycle Bin: the test company (…0004) has no active custom Desk module. The later import wizard steps (adding rows to a finished import with the same mapping, a department per row, downloading the error file, the time zone note, "skipped" versus "failed" rows) need a file upload, which this review does not do; they are in the test spec. Please create one custom Desk module with a few records on the staging company so we can test custom modules in Import, Export, Backup and the Recycle Bin.

Additional notes

Not gaps: Undo import works for 30 days (Zoho 14, longer is fine); Knowledge Base items go to the main Recycle Bin instead of a separate Knowledge Base bin (works another way); Ticket Archiving lets you choose 7 to 1095 days (Zoho fixes it at 120); Data Retention with legal holds, Data Archive and "Restore into a sandbox" go beyond Zoho and the PRD; Desk allows 2 sandboxes where Zoho allows 3; Attachment Controls and Data Subject Requests sit under Privacy and Security in Zoho, and GDPR erasure is a non-goal in NDC-1661; Zoho has no public API for Audit Log or Backup either.

Already filed, not repeated here: export without the Export Records permission (NDC-2306), the empty "All errors" table in Import (NDC-2385), "Delete forever" failing in the Recycle Bin (NDC-2248), the Audit Log not recording (NDC-2381).

One possible bug to check separately: the staging Desk app's settings point to production addresses (desk, crm, vault, analytics and omnichannel .anyware.software), so links handed out on staging may lead off staging.

Test spec: Desk Specs/spec-desk-data-administration.md in the QA repository. Nothing was changed on the tenant.

Environment

staging-desk.taviportal.com, Chromium, 24 October 2026, admin account.

raw_module_items.name: Data Administration: user stories for the functions not built yet
raw_module_items.description_html:
Summary

One user story for each missing function in NDC-2494 (same numbers), written to match Zoho Desk and NDC-1661 / 1662 / 1663 / 1664. Story 19 covers what could not be checked.

Import

1. As an admin moving a customer in, I want to upload one ZIP with a CSV for each module, so that I don't run one import per module.

  1. Given a ZIP with Accounts.csv, Contacts.csv and Tickets.csv, when I upload it, then each file is matched to its module with no manual step.

  2. Given a file whose name matches no module, when I upload the ZIP, then it appears in an "Unmapped" tray where I can choose its module.

  3. When the import runs, then Accounts load first, then Contacts, then Tickets, so links between them work.

  4. Given a ZIP holding an .xls or .pdf file, when I upload it, then it is refused and the message names that file.

2. As an admin, I want to import and export Knowledge Base articles, so that I can move our help content in and out in bulk.

  1. When I open the module list in Import or Export, then Knowledge Base articles are in it.

  2. Given an articles file, when I import it, then each article lands in its category with its title, body and status.

  3. When I export articles, then the file has one row per article I can see.

Export

3. As a support manager, I want to export a saved view or records that match my conditions, so that I get only the tickets I need.

  1. When I start an export, then I can choose All records, a saved view, or criteria with several conditions.

  2. Given a saved view, when I export it, then the file has exactly the records the view shows.

4. As a support manager, I want to choose the fields to export, so that the file holds only the columns I need.

  1. When I start an export, then I can pick all fields or a chosen list from every layout of the module.

  2. Then the file has exactly the chosen columns.

5. As a support manager, I want to export records from a date range, so that I can pull last month's tickets.

  1. When I choose All records, then I can filter by created, modified, closed or completed time.

  2. Then I can pick a preset range or a custom From and To.

  3. The file holds only records inside that range.

6. As an admin, I want to download an export again from Export history, so that I don't have to run it twice.

  1. Given a completed export, when I open Export history, then the row has a Download link.

  2. Given an export older than 7 days, when I open its link, then I see "This export has expired", not a blank or 404 page.

7. As an admin, I want to be told when my export is ready, so that I can leave the page while it runs.

  1. When an export finishes, then I get an email and an in-app notification with a link to it.

  2. When an export fails, then the notification says it failed.

8. As an admin handling sensitive data, I want to protect an export with a password, so that the file is safe if it is sent to the wrong person.

  1. When I tick "Protect with a password", then the password must have 8+ characters, upper case, lower case, a digit and a special character.

  2. Then the file cannot be opened without the password.

  3. Other admins cannot see the password.

9. As an admin, I want to filter Export history, so that I can find one export quickly.

  1. When I open Export history, then I can filter by module, user, time and status.

  2. Filters combine, and "Clear filters" brings back the full list.

Data Backup

10. As the account owner, I want only me to take backups, so that a full copy of our data cannot be taken by any admin.

  1. Given an admin who is not the owner, when they open Data Backup by menu or direct link, then they cannot see or use it.

  2. The same user gets 403 from the backup API.

11. As the account owner, I want one full backup per 30 days, so that storage stays under control.

  1. Given a full backup in the last 30 days, when I start another full backup, then it is blocked.

  2. Then the message shows the next date a full backup is allowed.

  3. A custom backup can still run.

12. As the account owner, I want a Backup Logs list, so that I can see everything that happened to our backups.

  1. When I open Backup Logs, then I see entries for: configuration set, backup scheduled, ready to download, download started, schedule stopped.

  2. Each entry shows who and when.

Audit Log

13. As an admin investigating an incident, I want the IP address on each audit entry, so that I can tell where a change came from.

  1. When I open an entry, then I see the IP address of the person who made the change.

  2. Given a contact is deleted, then its entry shows the contact, the person, the time and the IP address.

14. As an admin, I want the department on each entry and a Department filter, so that I can check one department's changes.

  1. Each entry about a department's records shows that department.

  2. When I filter by a department, then only its entries show, combined with the other filters.

15. As an admin, I want a custom date range in the Audit Log, so that I can look at an exact period.

  1. When I open the time filter, then I can pick Today, Last 7 days or a custom From and To.

  2. Only entries inside the range show.

16. As a compliance reviewer, I want clear rules for exporting the Audit Log, so that exports are controlled and I know when they are ready.

  1. Given a range longer than the limit, when I export, then it is refused and the message states the limit.

  2. Given an export is already running, when I start another, then it is refused with a clear message.

  3. After 50 exports in a day, a new export is refused.

  4. When an export finishes, then I get an email.

Sandbox and Migration

17. As an admin, I want to deploy tested changes from a sandbox to production, so that I don't redo them by hand.

  1. When I open a sandbox's changes, then I see each change marked Qualified or Conflict.

  2. When I deploy, then Qualified changes reach production and Conflict changes are listed and skipped.

  3. The deployment is written to the production Audit Log.

18. As an admin moving from another help desk, I want to migrate from Freshdesk, Salesforce and other tools, so that I am not limited to Zendesk.

  1. When I start a new migration, then I can choose the source help desk.

  2. Tickets with conversations, contacts and accounts come over, as they do for Zendesk today.

Could not be checked

19. As QA, I want a custom Desk module with records on the staging company, so that we can confirm custom modules work in Import, Export, Backup and the Recycle Bin.

  1. Given a custom module with records, when I open Import or Export, then the module is in the list.

  2. When I take a backup, then the module has its own CSV.

  3. When I delete one of its records, then it appears in the Recycle Bin and can be restored.

Please create one custom Desk module with a few records on the staging company so we can run story 19. The later import wizard steps (adding rows to a finished import, department per row, error file, time zone note, skipped versus failed rows) will be checked in the functional run of the test spec.

Environment

staging-desk.taviportal.com, Chromium, 24 October 2026, admin account.
